cases.question: Explain how a bi-encoder retrieves relevant documents.
cases.submissionText: Questions and documents are encoded independently into vectors. Document vectors can be indexed in advance, and retrieval ranks candidates by vector similarity to the question vector.

criteria.description: Explain independent encoding (4 points), similarity ranking (4 points) and precomputed document index (2 points).

reference.note: Constructed complete answer; illustrative rubric label, not teacher-graded.

cases.question: Explain how a bi-encoder retrieves relevant documents.
cases.submissionText: There is no independent encoding: the question and document must always be joined. Vector similarity is never used, and documents cannot be indexed in advance.

criteria.description: Explain independent encoding (4 points), similarity ranking (4 points) and precomputed document index (2 points).

reference.note: Constructed negation case to expose literal keyword bias; not teacher-graded.
